text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Summer Training Camp has begun once again. 
Last year, an injury prevented her from 
pushing herself hard, but this year was a 
whole different story.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente also revealed her regret over 
last year, burning with resolve to train 
thoroughly this year.
